Completed the full critique in the configured window. The main finding is that the draft’s parser-position guarantees need a release-specific check: open upstream reports describe CRLF position errors and line-count errors after mismatched-width records ([#395](https://github.com/BurntSushi/rust-csv/issues/395), [#422](https://github.com/BurntSushi/rust-csv/issues/422)). The critique also covers temporal support, station identity wording, import recovery, and export portability.
